title: 第四章 比凶兽还凶残

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    对于凶兽的大名，楚枫早有耳闻。
是一种可以修炼的怪物，从弱到强分为九阶，与灵武九重的修武者相互对应。
不过据说，三阶凶兽的实力，可远强过灵武三重的修武者，甚至能够与灵武四重的高手较量。
所以，就算是楚枫也不敢大意，他知道这里有机关，只要触发凶兽就会现身。
“砰”突然，一声闷响传来，一道关押凶兽的石门正在开启。
“奇怪，我还未踏入大殿，石门怎么就“砰砰砰砰砰......”可是紧随其后，大殿两侧总共四十道石门，竟然全部这下楚枫傻眼了，因为在那些黑暗的石门内，一双双血红色的眼睛已经睁开，一股强大的杀气充斥了整座大殿。
“我操，这不是玩我吧？”楚枫破口大骂，他明明听说，每次考核的最后一关，是一只凶兽，但现在是怎么个情况。
“呜嗷~~~”可是眼下，楚枫根本没时间去想太多，因为密密麻麻的身影已是自石门内窜出，进入了大殿之内。
他可以清晰的看见，这群怪物的模样，体型似猛虎，但却比猛虎足足大一倍。
身上乌黑一片，能够看见的只有那如刃一般的利爪獠牙，以及一双血红色的双眼。
总共四十只凶兽，它们的外貌没有不同，应该是同一品种，不过仔细观察后楚枫发现，它们的额头竟有奇怪的纹路，显然那就是它们等阶的标志。
“哇喔~”就在这时，一只凶兽怒吼一声，竟将目光投向了大殿深处的高台。
与此同时，所有凶兽的目光，都投向了高台，并且露出了垂涎之色。
“靠，你们这群强盗。”见状，楚枫大怒，如此珍品他怎会让这些凶兽享用，怒骂一声，便向高台飞奔而去。
“呜嗷”而在楚枫刚刚进入大殿，便很快引起了凶兽的注意。
这下可倒好，足足四十只凶兽，竟同时放弃仙灵草，全部向楚枫围攻而来，仿佛对它们来说，人类的血肉比灵药更具有诱惑力。
“滚开。”一只二阶凶兽迎面而来，然而楚枫只是一拳，便将它的头颅打爆，根本不堪一击。
但与此同时，足足数只凶兽已是围攻而至，那种可怕的杀气，足以将一个人吓得浑身颤抖。
然而楚枫却并未恐惧，他矫健如灵猴，左蹦右跳的穿梭在凶兽群中，每出一招，必有一只凶兽毙命。
此时此刻，与残忍的凶兽相比，楚枫更像是一只可怕的怪物，他的身体各处都是坚不可摧的利器，任凭凶兽再皮糙肉厚，却也抵挡不住他的一击。

这一刻，楚枫能够感觉到，在他体内奔腾的不止是天地灵气，还有那让他又爱又恨的九色神雷，正是这神雷给了他如此强大的力量，将他肉体锻造的完美。
“吼”可就在楚枫杀的眼红之时，身后突然传来一道刺耳的怒吼。
他转身一望不由大惊，一只巨大的凶兽利爪，已是对他的脑袋抓来。
这只巨爪与众不同，比起其他凶兽不知强大多少倍，若是被它抓中，脑袋定要粉碎。
“唰。”楚枫下意识的便向后一窜，想要躲开这道巨爪。
然而那巨爪速度实在太快，楚枫的脑袋虽然躲开了攻击，但它却狠狠的抓在了楚枫的胸口之上。
“呃啊~~”胸口被撕裂出五道血淋淋的伤口，致命的疼痛让楚枫忍不住大叫起来。
“我要撕了你。”然而疼痛之余，楚枫更多的却是愤怒。
他已经看见，袭击他的那只凶兽，额头上有着四道纹路，可见这是一只四阶凶兽。
换做是他人，肯定掉头便跑，因为哪怕是同一境界，但凶兽的力量肯定强于人类。
可楚枫不但没有逃跑，反而疯狂的向那凶兽扑了过去，他这一不要命的举动，就连没有灵智的凶兽们，也是下意识的一愣。
然而就是凶兽愣神的功夫，楚枫一拳结结实实的打在了它的额头之上。
没有意想中的血花四溅，却传来一声如钢铁碰撞的巨响。
甚至楚枫感到了拳头一阵酸麻，仿佛他那一拳不是打在了凶兽的头上，而是打在了铜墙铁壁一般。
“呜嗷~”
不过楚枫这一拳也是非同小可，那凶兽痛苦的哀嚎一声，竟向后退了几步，显然它也是感到了疼痛。
“给我去死。”
见自己的攻击尚有作用，楚枫也不再留手，抡起胳膊，漫天的拳影开始四处纷飞，沉重的拳头如同暴雨一般，连绵不断的砸在那凶兽身上。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast channel. Chu Feng has long heard of the name of the ferocious beast.
It is a kind of monster that can be cultivated. It is divided into nine levels from weak to strong, corresponding to the ninth level of spiritual martial arts cultivators.
However, it is said that the strength of the third-level ferocious beasts is far stronger than that of the third-level spiritual warriors, and can even compete with the masters of the fourth-level spiritual warriors.
Therefore, even Chu Feng did not dare to be careless. He knew that there was a mechanism here, and the vicious beast would appear as long as it was triggered.
"Bang" suddenly, there was a muffled sound, and a stone door where ferocious beasts were imprisoned was opening.
"It's strange, before I stepped into the main hall, why did the stone gates bang bang bang bang..." But immediately after, there were a total of forty stone gates on both sides of the hall. Chu Feng was dumbfounded, because in those dark stone gates, pairs of blood-red eyes had opened, and a powerful murderous aura filled the entire hall.
"Fuck, you're not playing with me, are you? "Chu Feng cursed loudly. He had clearly heard that the last level of each assessment was a ferocious beast, but what is the situation now.
"Aww~~~" But right now, Chu Feng didn't have time to think too much, because a dense crowd of figures had already emerged from the stone door and entered the main hall.
He could clearly see that these monsters looked like tigers, but were twice as big.
The body was completely black, and all that could be seen were the sharp claws and fangs like blades, and a pair of blood-red eyes.
There were a total of forty ferocious beasts. Their appearance was the same and they should be of the same species. However, after careful observation, Chu Feng discovered that there were strange lines on their foreheads, which were obviously signs of their level.
"Wow~" At this moment, a ferocious beast roared and turned its attention to the high platform deep in the hall.
At the same time, all the ferocious beasts' eyes were cast on the high platform, and they showed salivation.
“Damn, you bandits. "Seeing this, Chu Feng was furious. How could he let these ferocious beasts enjoy such a treasure? He cursed angrily and flew towards the high platform.
"Aww" As soon as Chu Feng entered the hall, he quickly attracted the attention of the ferocious beast.
This was a good time. A total of forty ferocious beasts gave up the fairy grass at the same time and all attacked Chu Feng. It seemed that to them, human flesh and blood was more attractive than the elixir.
"Go away. "A second-level ferocious beast came towards me, but Chu Feng blew its head open with just one punch, making it vulnerable to a single blow.
But at the same time, several ferocious beasts were besieging him, and their terrifying murderous intent was enough to scare a person to the point of trembling all over.
However, Chu Feng was not afraid. He was as vigorous as a monkey, jumping left and right among the ferocious beasts. Every time he made a move, one of the ferocious beasts would be killed.
At this moment, compared to the cruel ferocious beast, Chu Feng was more like a terrifying monster. Every part of his body was filled with indestructible weapons. No matter how rough the beast was, it could not withstand his blow.
At this moment, Chu Feng could feel that it was not only the spiritual energy of heaven and earth that was running in his body, but also the nine-color divine thunder that he loved and hated. It was this divine thunder that gave him such powerful power and forged his body to perfection.
"Roar" But just when Chu Feng was jealous, a harsh roar suddenly came from behind.
He turned around and was shocked to see a huge vicious beast clawing at his head.
This giant claw is unique. It is many times stronger than other ferocious beasts. If it catches it, the head will be smashed.
"Uh-huh. "Chu Feng subconsciously ran backwards, trying to avoid this giant claw.
However, the speed of the giant claw was too fast. Although Chu Feng's head escaped the attack, it grabbed Chu Feng's chest fiercely.
"Uh-huh~" Five bloody wounds were torn out on his chest, and the fatal pain made Chu Feng couldn't help but scream.
"IGonna tear you apart. "However, apart from the pain, Chu Feng was even more angry.
He had already seen that the ferocious beast that attacked him had four lines on its forehead, which showed that it was a fourth-level ferocious beast.
If it were someone else, they would definitely turn around and run away, because even if they were in the same realm, the power of ferocious beasts would definitely be stronger than that of humans.
But instead of running away, Chu Feng rushed towards the ferocious beast crazily. His desperate move caused even the unconscious ferocious beasts to be stunned subconsciously.
However, the ferocious beast was stunned, and Chu Feng hit it firmly on the forehead with a punch.
There was no blood splashing as expected, but there was a loud sound like the collision of steel.
Chu Feng even felt a numbness in his fist, as if his punch had not hit the beast's head, but hit a copper wall.
"Ouch~"
However, Chu Feng's punch was no small matter. The ferocious beast howled in pain and took a few steps back. It was obvious that it also felt pain.
"Die to me. "
Seeing that his attack was still effective, Chu Feng no longer held back, raised his arms, and fist shadows began to fly everywhere in the sky. The heavy fists were like heavy rain, continuously hitting the fierce beast.
